The online A/B test got about **10% of Netflix traffic** and ran for **4 weeks**. Both facts are on page 6, in Section 5.1: "We allocated approximately 10% of Netflix traffic for 4 weeks."

The test focused on key batch-compute surfaces and compared GenRec with the mature production ranker (p. 6). In a configuration with little data and few input signals, GenRec showed statistically significant gains on both short-term and long-term online metrics, including a +0.006% relative improvement on the core online metric (p. 6, Figure 3).
